purpose: Verify workflow-level cancellation when a new authorized branch push has both signing and installation jobs skipped by their event guards.
invalid_run_identity: gogoke native-host CI, workflow_dispatch, codex/gogoke-37-l0; neither the required main branch nor candidate-sign workflow nor signing workflow name
safety: Production Assert-Run must reject this signing-run identity before artifact download or installation if it gets that far. No candidate key is present in the consumer. No installer or release is exercised by this control.
expected: Consumer is cancelled by the push-triggered run in the same fixed concurrency group; both push-run execution jobs remain skipped.

actual.execution_jobs: Both skipped; no signing or installation steps
actual.scope_limit: Consumer preflight rejected the deliberately invalid signing identity before cancellation completed. This proves live shared-group workflow cancellation, not interruption of a productive install.

non_claims: This is a cancellation and negative-identity control only, not a signed-candidate smoke pass or a product milestone.
